title: A family detecting zero still detects zero after tensoring with a vector space
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $M,N$ be $k$-vector spaces, let $J$ be a set and let $(P_j)_{j\in J}$ be $k$-vector spaces. Let $f_j:M\to P_j$ be $k$-linear maps such that for every $m\in M$, $(\forall j\in J,\ f_j(m)=0)$ implies $m=0$. For $t\in M\otimes_kN$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], if $(f_j\otimes\mathrm{id}_N)(t)=0$ for every $j\in J$, then $t=0$. No finiteness or nonemptiness assumption is imposed on $J$ and no finite-dimensionality assumption is imposed on the vector spaces.
